# Tapahtumatyypit ja luokat

The viewer adds an **Event type** column to every dataset that has an event column (`event`, `events`, `event_type` or `event_name`). Each game's own words are mapped to one of these kinds (upper and lower case alike); a word not listed counts as *Other*.

| Kind | Shown as | Words in the data |
|---|---|---|
| `position` | Sijainti | `(empty)`, `position`, `pos`, `sample`, `move`, `vehicle` |
| `fire` | Laukaus | `burst`, `shot`, `gun_shot`, `fire`, `fire_start`, `fire_stop`, `weapon_fire`, `slash`, `hasfired`, `shoot`, `fired`, `tracer` |
| `launch` | Laukaisu (ohjus, raketti, pommi) | `launch`, `launched`, `torpedo`, `throw`, `release` |
| `hit` | Osuma | `hit`, `hit_critical`, `hit_severe`, `struck`, `impact`, `hasbeenhitby` |
| `miss` | Ohi | `miss`, `missed` |
| `explosion` | Räjähdys | `explosion`, `flak`, `he`, `molotov`, `inferno`, `smoke`, `flash`, `explode` |
| `damage` | Vahinko | `hurt`, `damage`, `damaged`, `module_destroyed`, `wounded`, `fire_on`, `blind` |
| `kill` | Tuho | `kill`, `kills` |
| `death` | Kuolema | `death`, `dead`, `died`, `killed` |
| `destroyed` | Tuhoutunut | `destroyed` |
| `crash` | Maahansyöksy | `crash`, `crashed` |
| `eject` | Heittoistuin | `eject`, `ejected`, `bailout`, `bailedout` |
| `spawn` | Ilmestyminen | `spawn`, `respawn`, `revived`, `created` |
| `despawn` | Katoaminen | `despawn`, `removed`, `leftarea`, `timeout` |
| `takeoff` | Lentoonlähtö | `takenoff`, `takeoff` |
| `landing` | Lasku | `landed`, `landing` |
| `touchdown` | Maakosketus | `touchdown`, `touch_and_go` |
| `stop` | Pysähdys | `stop`, `parked` |
| `rearm` | Uudelleenaseistus / tankkaus | `rearm`, `rearmed`, `refuel`, `refuelled`, `refueled`, `repair`, `repaired` |
| `capture` | Valtaus / tavoite | `captured`, `capture`, `neutralised`, `neutralized`, `plant`, `defuse` |
| `decoy` | Harhautin | `flare`, `chaff`, `decoy`, `countermeasure` |
| `message` | Viesti | `chat`, `message`, `command`, `bookmark`, `debug`, `comment` |
| `other` | Muu | `grenade`, `projectile`, `nade`, `thrown`, `flight` |

## Vehicle classes

The **Vehicle class** and **Target class** columns use these classes, worked out from vehicle names (through the [figure catalogue](figures.md)) and type columns.

| Class | Shown as |
|---|---|
| `fighter` | Hävittäjä |
| `attack` | Hyökkäyskone |
| `bomber` | Pommittaja |
| `otherAir` | Muu ilma-alus |
| `helicopter` | Helikopteri |
| `tank` | Panssarivaunu |
| `armoured` | Panssaroitu ajoneuvo |
| `spaa` | Ilmatorjunta |
| `artillery` | Tykistö |
| `truck` | Kuorma-auto / auto |
| `ship` | Laiva |
| `submarine` | Sukellusvene |
| `infantry` | Jalkaväki |
| `weapon` | Ase |
| `decoy` | Harhautin |
| `structure` | Rakennelma |
| `other` | Muu |
